verdict.rationale: Missive's docs describe snoozing, which hides a conversation until a chosen time and then returns it to the Inbox. Snooze can be triggered by swipe or from the ⌘/Ctrl+K command bar, so the snooze half of the story is clearly delivered. Nothing shows a conditional follow-up reminder that brings a thread back only if nobody replies; snooze resurfaces on a timer whether or not anyone answered. Missing for 10: reply-conditional follow-up reminders, snooze options such as presets or custom times, independent or hands-on corroboration.
